thread:
nisha: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — shard-12 KV residency leak that triggered an OOM yesterday. Capturing owners, short-term mitigations, and next steps here. Ping if you're taking any of these.

leo: Assigning owners: @leo to triage profiler traces, @sara to GC + allocator config, @jamal for canary rollback plan. ops-bot to keep an eye on prod alerts.

sara: I'll run a GC intensity and fragmentation sweep in staging today. Hypothesis: slab fragmentation + large prefix_map entries. Plan: run `ALLOC_DEBUG=1 ./bin/kvprof --sample=1s` and produce flamegraphs.

jamal: Canary/rollback note: we can temporarily switch traffic to reduced-residency variant `kv.v2-q4-soft` which sets softlimit=0.6 and disables large-prefix caching. Steps will be added to the runbook.

nisha: Short-term mitigations (target: EOD prod changes):
  1) reduce shard kv softlimit on prod -> 0.6 (sara)
  2) temp KCACHE eviction TTL -> 30s for affected shards (jamal)
  3) enable slab compaction job on shard-12 (leo)
  4) add an alert for residency drift >0.7 (leo)

leo: Scheduled compaction job at 21:00 UTC. Script snippet: ```for s in shard-12; do curl -XPOST "http://orchestrator/api/v1/compact?s=$s" -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'; done``` I will tail compaction logs and post output here.

ops-bot: [incident-bot] OOM cleared on node shard-12 (2026-03-22T21:45:03Z). Memory usage reported: before=62GB, after=18GB following eviction.

sara: Staging GC run finished. Flamegraph uploaded: https://internal/fg/2332. Observed repeated small allocations pinned in `prefix_map` region; alloc churn at ~120k allocs/min. Suggest adding guardrails on prefix_map growth + defensive trimming.

jamal: I'll prepare a 10% canary of `kv.v2-q4-soft` tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Canary conditions: error rate >2% OR p95 latency +5% -> auto revert. Will add playbook steps and rollback command.

nisha: Owners & deadlines:
  - leo: compaction automation + residency telemetry (histograms/alerts) by 2026-03-23 COB
  - sara: prefix_map guardrail implementation + unit/integration tests by 2026-03-27
  - jamal: canary rollout + rollback playbook by 2026-03-24
I'll review PRs once opened.

leo: Telemetry plan: add `kv.residency.p50/p95` histograms, and alert when residency >0.7 for 5m. Also emitting `kv.compaction.duration` and `kv.eviction.count`. I'll open a telemetry PR now.

sara: Quick question — for guardrail behavior do we prefer soft eviction at write time (reject/evict on insert) or preemptive trimming on idle? My leaning: preemptive trimming every 60s to avoid write tail latencies.

jamal: Preemptive trimming seems lower risk for latency spikes. I'll add `kv.prefix_map.items` metric so we can alarm before residency hits threshold.

nisha: Agreed on preemptive trimming. Additionally, schedule a nightly heap-scan (non-peak window) for shard-12 for the next 3 weeks to detect recurring patterns. I'll add that to infra cron.

ops-bot: Reminder: postmortem doc updated -> https://docs/internal/postmortems/kv-shard12-leak. PR reference: https://git/repo/PR-4522.

leo: After compaction script validation I'll add a short runbook snippet to ops-playbooks with exact compaction + rollback commands.

sara: I'll attach new unit and integration tests for `prefix_map` trimming and allocate a test dataset that reproduces fragmentation locally.

jamal: :thumbsup:

nisha: Check-ins: please update this thread when tasks move to in-progress/completed. I'll run a 3-week lookback for recurring leak patterns next Monday and share findings here. Thanks all.
